text: I started from letters numbers and everytime i take the bus i listen to every station while looking at the front monitor(where the next station is written). Then i copy how they pronounce words and looking at how it is spelled. I also listen to israeli music everyday on youtube especially those with lyrics thats how i started learning how to read and write honestly. I dont watch tv or news btw. The music helped me a lot. Btw your partner’s support and help is a big plus. He corrects my pronunciation and spellings and writings ☺️☺️Good luck 🙏🏼🙏🏼 learning by yourself is a little hard but if you put your heart on it you can do it.
